name: Cosmic Warp Slideshow
description: Full-screen image slideshow where each new slide warps in from below or above with a stretched zoom, with a thumbnail strip, wave-style drag lines, counter and animated slide titles.
contents: Series title, slide counter with previous and next arrows, animated slide title
Wave of vertical lines that rises under the active thumbnail
Thumbnail strip for jumping to a slide
Hint text in the top right corner
behavior: Next slide scales and slides in from below or above while the image stretches vertically into place
Navigation by mouse wheel, touch swipe, arrow keys, arrows, or thumbnail click
Navigation is queued while a transition is running
Drag lines form a wave around the hovered or active thumbnail
Slide title fades and slides vertically on change
editableByProps: Slide images, titles, series title and hint text
Drag line count and heights, thumbnail width

needsCodeEdit.where: performTransition method of the Slideshow class

fixed: Listens for wheel, touch and arrow key events on the whole document while mounted and removes them on unmount
Series title, counter and thumbnails are pinned to the bottom of the viewport and the hint to the top right
Drag line wave assumes a 720px wide control area
Slide count and title count should match
